— An old trail —
A game trail crosses your path — two toes, heart-shaped, heading for water.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You catch fragments by the fire — Henry telling Pule about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
— Open ground —
Wildflowers in clumps — purple, white, yellow. You don't know their names yet, and the not-knowing is a kind of hunger.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 8 people, 3 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
